Walkley Winners Archive
The archive of Walkley-winning stories is housed in the State Library of New South Wales. The Walkley Foundation is committed to creating an accessible, online archive of this impressive body of work, and launched a pilot platform in April 2019 (you can view it here ).
The Foundation is seeking further funding to complete the project. If you would like any information on this, or would be interested in supporting the project with a tax-deductible donation, please contact Barbara Blackman or donate online here .
